product_brief: A high-assurance cryptographic library in Rust using formally verified code from the HACL* project.
pqc_capability_description: Supports ML-KEM (CRYSTALS-Kyber) via `libcrux-ml-kem` and ML-DSA (CRYSTALS-Dilithium) via `libcrux-ml-dsa`. Also includes hybrid KEMs like X25519MlKem768Draft00 and XWing. The library is in pre-release (version < 0.1) and users are advised to contact maintainers before production use.
crypto_primitives: ML-KEM, P256 DHKEM, X25519 ECDH, X25519MlKem768Draft00, XWing, AES-GCM, AES-CCM, ChaCha20Poly1305, XChaCha20Poly1305, BLAKE2, SHA2, SHA3, P256 ECDSA, ML-DSA, Ed25519, RSA-PSS, HKDF, HMAC, Poly1305
implementation_attack_surface: Executables are not verified to be side-channel resistant, though source code attempts to be secret-independent (constant-time).
testing_&_validation_methods: Formal verification using the hax toolchain and HACL* project (verified for memory safety, functional correctness, and secret independence).
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Supports no_std environments given a global allocator.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Library is in pre-release; users advised to contact maintainers for production fit.

product_brief: A ring-compatible cryptographic library using AWS-LC for operations, providing FIPS support for Rust developers.
pqc_capability_description: The document does not mention any Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) algorithms or support. It focuses on FIPS validation and compatibility with the `ring` library.
fips_validated: Yes (AWS-LC-FIPS 3.x has completed FIPS validation testing by an accredited lab and has been submitted to NIST for certification)
primary_platforms: Linux targets (static build of AWS-LC-FIPS); Rust programming language
regulatory_status: FIPS validation testing completed; submitted to NIST for certification
testing_&_validation_methods: FIPS validation testing by an accredited lab
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Designed as a drop-in replacement for ring (v0.16) to allow seamless integration

product_brief: The std.crypto module provides cryptographic primitives including authenticated encryption, hashing, key derivation, digital signatures, and elliptic curve operations.
pqc_capability_description: Supports ML-DSA (Post-Quantum) digital signatures (MlDsa44, MlDsa65, MlDsa87) and ML-KEM (Kyber) Key Encapsulation (MlKem512, MlKem768, MlKem1024).
crypto_primitives: AEGIS, ChaCha20-Poly1305, AES-GCM, AES-GCM-SIV, AES-SIV, AES-OCB, AES-CCM, SHA-2, SHA-3, BLAKE2, BLAKE3, MD5, SHA-1, HMAC, SipHash, Poly1305, Argon2, bcrypt, scrypt, PBKDF2, HKDF, Ed25519, ECDSA, ML-DSA, Curve25519, Edwards25519, Ristretto255, P256, P384, Secp256k1, X25519, ML-KEM
signature_schemes: Ed25519, ECDSA (P256, P384, Secp256k1), ML-DSA (MlDsa44, MlDsa65, MlDsa87)
implementation_attack_surface: Timing-Safe Operations provided (eql, compare) to prevent timing attacks.

product_brief: A lattice-based digital signature scheme software suite with reference and optimized implementations.
pqc_support: Yes (CRYSTALS Dilithium is a lattice-based post-quantum signature algorithm)
pqc_capability_description: Provides software implementations of the CRYSTALS Dilithium post-quantum signature scheme. Includes reference (ref) and AVX2-optimized builds. Supports parameter sets 2, 3, 5, and their AES variants (2aes, 3aes, 5aes). Includes KAT generation, test vectors, and verification tests.
testing_&_validation_methods: Includes PQCgenKAT (NIST Known Answer Tests), deterministic test vector generation for compatibility, and functional testing (10,000 iterations of key generation, signing, and verification).

product_brief: A lattice-based Key Encapsulation Mechanism (KEM) software suite with reference and optimized implementations.
pqc_support: Yes (CRYSTALS-Kyber is a lattice-based PQC algorithm; the document lists it as a NIST PQC candidate and provides software implementations).
pqc_capability_description: Provides software implementations of the CRYSTALS-Kyber Key Encapsulation Mechanism (KEM). Supports parameter sets Kyber-512, Kyber-512-90s, Kyber-768, Kyber-768-90s, Kyber-1024, and Kyber-1024-90s. Includes reference (ref) and AVX2 optimized builds. Integrated into liboqs, PQClean, Botan, and Bouncy Castle.
primary_platforms: Intel CPU (for cycle counting benchmarks); Linux/Unix-like systems (implied by git/make); JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust, Python, Java, Go, C++ (via Botan)
testing_&_validation_methods: Includes test_kyber (key generation, encapsulation, decapsulation tests), test_kex (authenticated key exchange tests), test_vectors (deterministic test vectors for compatibility), test_speed (benchmarks), and PQCgenKAT_kem (NIST test-vector generation).

product_brief: Stateless hash-based signature software with parameter exploration scripts and third-party implementations.
pqc_support: Yes (SPHINCS+ is a stateless hash-based signature scheme, recognized as PQC)
pqc_capability_description: Provides SPHINCS+ stateless hash-based signatures. Includes software for building binaries for all submitted parameter sets and benchmarking. Offers a parameter exploration SAGE script. Integrated into Botan C++ crypto library (release 3.0) and Bouncy Castle BCPQC provider. Includes Go, Java, and Low-RAM implementations. Supports hybrid scheme with LMS.
testing_&_validation_methods: Benchmarking via python3 benchmark.py; parameter exploration via SAGE script.
constrained_device_&_iot_suitability: Low-RAM-SPHINCS+ implementation designed to minimize RAM usage; can use as little as 1k of RAM for SHA2-128F-SIMPLE parameter set.
